name: My Life with You
storyline: "My Life with You" tells the story of a young woman who, after falling in love as a teenager, ends up getting pregnant. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she must face the challenges of being a single mother, balancing work, household responsibilities, and her dream of building a better future for herself and her child. Living with her grandmother, she seeks a job to support their home while dealing with the struggles of motherhood and the possibility of finding love again. At the core of it all is the bond between mother and child, showing the highs and lows of a journey filled with challenges, growth, and love.
summary: My Life with You is a gentle, text-light narrative experience in which you follow the daily journey of a young single mother navigating life’s challenges—caring for her child, searching for work, and managing household responsibilities while living with her grandmother. The game focuses on the emotional bond between mother and child, balancing struggles and growth at a self-paced rhythm, free from timers or pressure.
